title: TopologyOverlaySignalIntent
description: Bounded intent for compiling a catalog-backed topology metric/state overlay through the existing overlays:compile endpoint.

catalogIds.description: Semantic catalog ids selected from scoped overlay signal availability.

deliveryMode.description: Requested delivery mode. topology-service validates it against scoped signal availability.

preferredEffects.description: Requested visual effects in preference order. topology-service validates and may select the supported subset.

thresholds.description: Optional backend-evaluated threshold comparisons for color/ring/width effects.

label.description: Optional short layer label requested by the caller.
